name: Citizens' forum on climate-friendly energy supply in Baden-Württemberg
content: Problems and Purpose Baden-Württemberg climate assembly aimed to enable the citizens to form a well-founded opinion about the social effects of various measures to reduce CO2 Evaluate Academy scenarios and finally design and justify an energy scenario.Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding EntitiesBaden-Württemberg Regional GovernmentAcademy for Technology Assessment BaWüParticipant Recruitment and Selection 220 citizens were recruited randomly across the city region.
